flows:
Navigate to https://www.ventusky.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Press Tab about eight times from fresh page focus.
Find Precipitation immediately after the Forecast selector and Temperature options.
Activate it once it visibly has focus.
Use Tab and Enter to switch from Temperature to Precipitation and verify the 3 hours accumulation option.
